name: magalu-mcp
description: Magalu Marketplace (ecommerce channels): me, set_inventory, end_listing, list_orders. Every tool map

platform_mcp_magalu_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MAGALU_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_magalu_client_id.description: Client ID of your application created with the ID Magalu CLI (see developers.magalu.com > Primeiros passos > Criar aplicação).

platform_mcp_magalu_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MAGALU_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_magalu_client_secret.description: Client secret of the same application.

platform_mcp_magalu_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MAGALU_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_magalu_refresh_token.description: Refresh token from a one-time authorization-code consent of the seller at https://id.magalu.com (scopes such as open:portfolio:read/write, open:order-order:read). If ID Magalu returns a new refresh token on refresh, the runtime keeps it (and saves it with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR).

platform_mcp_magalu_channel_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MAGALU_CHANNEL_ID
platform_mcp_magalu_channel_id.description: Sales channel id the stock applies to (GET /seller/v1/portfolios/me returns channel.id).

tools.name: me
tools.description: portfolios_v1_get_me: {tenant: {id}, channel: {id, name}, seller: {id, name}} of the authenticated seller.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: portfolios_v1_patch_stocks PATCH /seller/v1/portfolios/stocks/{sku} {channel: {id}, type: AVAILABLE, quantity} sets the available stock of your SKU (`sku` required) on the configured channel. Asynchronous (202 + trace_id).

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: portfolios_v1_patch_skus PATCH /seller/v1/portfolios/skus/{sku} {active: false} deactivates the SKU (partial update; reversible with active: true). `listing_id` is your SKU. Asynchronous (202 + trace_id).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: seller_v1_get_order_list ?status(new|approved|...)&purchased_at__gte(ISO-8601 with offset)&_offset&_limit, newest first. `id` is the platform order code. amounts.total is an integer to be divided by amounts.normalizer, so it is left in raw rather than mapped to `total`; deliveries (needed to ship) are in raw.
